verdict.rationale: EmailOctopus's API documentation lists a dedicated bulk endpoint, "Update multiple contacts of list", so the product itself offers a multi-item operation. The evidence is only a link title. It covers a single operation type (contact updates within one list), with no documented batch limits, bulk create/delete, or bulk actions on other entities. Missing for 10: documented bulk create/delete or bulk actions beyond contact updates, batch size and limit details, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the bulk endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
